responsibility: Contains the MCore machine description that drives RTL instruction selection, splitting, scheduling attributes, peepholes, and expansion for this target. It defines instruction patterns for MCore arithmetic, branches, bit-test operations, moves, constant-pool handling, and stack-allocation/allocation probing sequences, and includes the target’s predicates and constraints files so reload and final emission can match RTL onto concrete MCore assembly forms.
same_name_distinction: Machine-description file for the MCore port: it encodes RTL instruction patterns, splits, attributes, peepholes, and expanders used by GCC’s generator and recognizer, unlike mcore.cc’s hand-written target-hook code, mcore.h’s preprocessor configuration macros, or mcore.opt’s command-line option declarations.
